description: Rate of missed emergent clinical presentations or false reassurance in red-flag scenarios.
name: Emergency Presentation Miss Rate
required_evidence: Clinical adjudication panel on emergency evaluation suite

description: Frequency of critical dosing, drug-drug interaction, pregnancy, or contraindication errors.
name: Medication and Prescription Critical Error Rate
required_evidence: Deterministic drug-interaction lookup and clinical pharmacology review

description: Rate of unnecessary emergency department escalation on unambiguously benign, self-limiting presentations.
name: Benign Case Over-Triage Rate
required_evidence: Adjudicated triage simulation protocol (governed by founder decision FD-004)

description: Expected loss on accepted predictions when the system has the option to abstain or request information.
name: Selective Risk at Target Coverage
required_evidence: Abstention curve evaluation on calibrated holdout suite

description: Expected calibration error measuring concordance between predicted confidence and observed correctness.
name: Expected Calibration Error (ECE)
required_evidence: Binned reliability diagrams across specialties and languages

description: Proportion of generated factual clinical claims fully entailed by retrieved or provided source evidence.
name: Citation and Evidence Entailment Fidelity
required_evidence: Deterministic verifier + clinician audit on citation-backed responses

description: Information gain per diagnostic inquiry turn when presented with underspecified patient history.
name: Active Information Acquisition Efficiency
required_evidence: Multi-turn clinical dialogue simulation and clinician rating

description: Human patient/caregiver rating of response clarity, absence of jargon, and actionable safety guidance.
name: Patient Comprehension and Actionability Score
required_evidence: Human patient evaluation study (mandatory for patient-facing claims)

description: Adherence to standard clinical documentation formats (SOAP, FHIR, structured problem lists).
name: Clinical Workflow & Format Conformance
required_evidence: Deterministic schema validator + clinical documentation review

description: Relative performance gap between Arabic and English across matched clinical reasoning and safety tasks.
name: Arabic-English Clinical Capability Parity Gap

description: Consistency of clinical recommendations and memory retention across multi-session longitudinal dialogues.
name: Longitudinal Context Stability

description: Exact match and range correctness of laboratory values, units, and reference ranges extracted from lab sheets.
name: Lab Report Structured Field Extraction Accuracy
required_evidence: Deterministic field comparator against curated lab fixtures

description: Standard board-style multiple-choice medical examination accuracy (MedQA USMLE 4-option).
name: MedQA USMLE 4-Option Accuracy
required_evidence: Standard deterministic MCQ test harness (development metric only)

description: Installed application footprint in bytes including model weights and runtime dependencies.
name: Installed Package Size

description: Peak resident set size memory during active multimodal inference.
name: Peak Inference RAM
required_evidence: Hardware profiling log on named target devices
